title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud — Episode5 Effects and Rehearsal

meta.Event Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Line: A few days later
Diner

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see.
Which is why you'd like me to come up with a few simple effects for this story, yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sorry. I know this is very sudden.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After discussing this matter with Kusanagi, we realized that we need to take other things into consideration besides our acting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A lot of children are going to be present, and some may not actually be fans of these kinds of stories... So, I thought we should come prepared from as many angles as possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, they could prove to be quite a handful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be more than happy to lend a hand since I don't see myself getting many other opportunities to direct reading events.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But don't get too ahead of yourself, Rui.
This is just a plain old reading event.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No cannons or anything crazy like that, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: C-Cannons...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's unfortunate.
I figured that a small bolt of lightning would be an excellent way to gather the children's attention.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, that'd be...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know.
This story has a gentle quality to it, so I'll come up with ideas which complement that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on what you just said, there are going to be quite a few children there. Is the story by chance going to be presented on a projector?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh... Yes, that's right.
We'll have a screen set up on the stage in the gymnasium.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... In other words, you have quite a lot of space to work with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As an example... There's that scene where the dog ventures through a snowy field. What if we make it snow as you read that part?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Make it snow...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I have just the device.
All I'd have to do is make some minor adjustments.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I bet the children would love that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree...! Taking the events in this story and bringing them into our world would make it just that much more fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, let's include that in our plan.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What else can we do...?
Oh, we could play some bug and owl sounds during the night scene in the forest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...
That certainly would make it feel more lifelike.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Also, stars play a significant role in this story, so we could present them by...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Kamishiro never ceases to amaze me...
He just keeps coming up with all these different ideas.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And every effect sounds really fun.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think that's everything I have to offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, are there any requests that either of you would like to make?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, yes...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, I don't know if this is actually possible...
But is there some way to make it seem like the dog from this story is sitting right next to them?
The day before the event
Community Center

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all for agreeing to gather here today for this rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Hona and Nene are gonna read that story to us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how they present it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Though, it was a surprise to hear you'll be taking part, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I decided to volunteer after hearing Mochizuki talk about this event...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, if it's alright with all of you, I'd like to get started.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “And they lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank goodness the boy ended up being okay!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That dog really did his best...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I actually started tearing up a little at the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You did it, Mochizuki...
Your hard work is starting to pay off.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Tomorrow's the big day...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They both just put on a wonderful performance, so I'm looking forward to seeing how the children react.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Break a leg, Honami!>
